step.welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
step.welcome.subtitle: A quick (60s) tour of CoinVisio.
step.welcome.body: This intro is designed to be short and smooth - just enough to help you orient yourself.
step.welcome.note: CoinVisio provides market analytics and educational insights - not financial or investment advice.
step.coins.title: Coins, Charts & Alerts
step.coins.subtitle: Track 500+ assets and stay in sync.
step.coins.body: Explore multi-timeframe charts (hourly to multi-year), build watchlists, and receive notifications for important updates.
step.coins.tipText: Start with 3-5 coins you care about and pin them to your watchlist.
step.market.title: Market Pulse (Bias Tags)
step.market.subtitle: Indicators + models, summarized safely.
step.market.body: CoinVisio combines technical indicators (RSI/EMA/ATR) with lightweight forecasting to produce a market bias tag and confidence.
step.market.note: These tags are for context and scenario planning - they are not buy/sell instructions.
step.anomalies.title: Anomaly Radar
step.anomalies.subtitle: Spot unusual return/volume behaviour.
step.anomalies.body: Our anomaly detector scans for rare patterns in returns and volume change. It highlights unusual activity on the most recent data.
step.anomalies.note: Use anomalies as a heads-up to investigate - context matters (news, liquidity, macro).
step.insights.title: AI Insights + Daily Briefing
step.insights.subtitle: Risk-style baskets and a daily market summary.
step.insights.body: AI Insights groups coins into risk-style baskets (Conservative, Moderate, Aggressive) using indicators like RSI, volatility and volume shifts.
step.insights.note: These are informational sets - not recommendations or guarantees.
step.insights.dailyBody: Market digest built from CoinVisio Brain data: volatility, sector rotation, anomalies and major narratives - summarized for fast scanning.
step.iris.title: Iris AI
step.iris.subtitle: Ask, explore, and keep context.
step.iris.body: Iris can query CoinVisio's internal knowledge (RAG) and, when enabled, fetch public web sources. It keeps chat history and can cite references.
step.iris.prompt3: What changed in macro headlines this week?
step.done.title: You're ready
step.done.subtitle: Let's open your dashboard.
step.done.body: That's it. You can revisit settings anytime from your profile and tailor the experience to your style.
step.done.reminderText: Insights can be wrong. Always verify with multiple sources and manage risk responsibly.
